description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named ClaimEventSearchFilterParams used for filtering claim event searches in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base class FilterParams and includes properties for name, status, and id, along with their respective getter and setter methods. The class also specifies allowed sort fields and initializes the default sort field.

classes.name: ClaimEventSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used to specify filtering parameters for searching claim events, including filtering by name, status, and id.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters and sets the default sort field to 'claimEvent.name'.
